metadata.description: Bento: a box of small, well-made Claude Code mods — usage, awareness, agents, safety, dev, compact.

plugins.name: safety
plugins.description: Protected Files (deny writes to .env, lockfiles, vault files) and Auto-checkpoint (side-ref snapshots of the working tree). Spends no tokens.

plugins.name: usage
plugins.description: Burn Meter (5-hour and weekly limits with pace), Cache Clock (prompt-cache countdown and cold-return cost) and Compaction Alert, in one band row. Spends no tokens.

plugins.name: awareness
plugins.description: Tells you what is happening and what needs you, without noise: Heads-Up toasts (max 1 a minute, plus long command timer), Now Doing phase band, Spec Tracker and a Focus Timer that silences the toasts.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Pets in Still Room, Review Queue, Delegation Guard and Mission Board: subagents, unreviewed work, model policy with spend by tier, and plan progress across all agents. Replaces agent-pets.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Code state while agents work: git branch, session diff, test pulse, coverage delta, typecheck feedback, PR radar and port watch

plugins.name: compact
plugins.description: Compact Coach, /handoff, Resume loader and Orchestrator mode: compact at the right moment and keep the thread across it
